entities.name: IAB Other Information procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by IAB-MT to request the IAB-donor-CU to allocate IP address or inform the IAB-donor-CU of the IP address for the collocated IAB-DU.

entities.name: IABOtherInformation
entities.description: Message sent from IAB-MT to Network as part of the IAB Other Information procedure.

entities.name: IAB-MT
entities.description: IAB Mobile Termination entity that initiates the IAB Other Information procedure.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity (IAB-donor-CU) that receives the IABOtherInformation message.

entities.name: IP address allocation request
entities.description: Request for IAB-donor-CU to allocate IP address for the collocated IAB-DU.

entities.name: IP address information
entities.description: Information about IP address for the collocated IAB-DU provided to IAB-donor-CU.

relations.description: The IAB Other Information procedure involves sending the IABOtherInformation message.
IABOtherInformation message is sent to the Network (IAB-donor-CU).
The procedure can be used to request IP address allocation from IAB-donor-CU.
The procedure can be used to inform IAB-donor-CU about IP address for collocated IAB-DU.
